# Historical VOL-F reference replacement map
No separate VOL-F archive volume is implied. All old VOL-F labels (including their obsolete section numbers) resolve by subject to the following existing package-relative files. Old section numbers are not silently transposed onto new documents.
| Historical subject | Exact replacement | Remaining gate | |---|---|---| | Archive record, checkpoint, payload, gap and retention | `handbook/chd32/src/110-archives-restore.md`; `build-spec/integrated/duckbrain-schema.md` §§3,8 | G-07 native payload/API and G-12 schema/key/nullability selection | | Archive export/import operations | `contracts/openapi.yaml`; `handbook/chd32/runbooks/archive-capture.md` | G-07; D-039 current-policy activation mandatory | | Archive authorization/policy | `build-spec/integrated/config-format.md` §5.3; `handbook/chd32/src/60-authorization.md` | G-02 projection reconciliation; current lineage per archive page | | Audit durability/recovery and controller backup | `handbook/chd32/runbooks/controller-backup-restore.md`; `build-spec/integrated/duckbrain-schema.md` §8 | G-12 concrete fence/snapshot binding | | Federation/bridge/ACK | `build-spec/integrated/wire-api.md` §5; `handbook/chd32/src/120-deployment-federation.md` | Native/live bridge validation, no automatic peer authority | | Storage class config and effective routing | `build-spec/integrated/config-format.md`; `contracts/openapi.yaml` | G-03 runtime readback and G-12 storage boundary |
This closes absent-volume navigation only. It does not close the explicitly retained implementation/design gaps. Authority is [INTEGRATION.md](INTEGRATION.md), not this map's historical VOL-F name.
